relevance_note: Case report of one girl with a stated LAD-I diagnosis and individual-level detail: "The patient was diagnosed LAD-I at the age of seven years."
method_note: Built by hand with a small Python script in the scratch directory; every value is from my reading of the paper. Single case report; one individual ('patient', rule 5). Diagnosis is by flow cytometry (CD18 18.79%); the paper reports no ITGB2 variant and no genetic testing, so the variants table is empty. n_patients_reported is null because the field counts patients with an ITGB2 variant and none is described (the paper describes one LAD-I patient). The 'healthy parents' and the implied older sibling ('second child') are not tested or affected and were given no rows; country not stated for the patient (only author affiliations in Iran), so ethnicity_or_country is not reported. Severity of periodontitis is inconsistent in the Discussion ('severe periodentitis' vs 'mild periodentitis'); presence is consistent, recorded in severity_or_detail. Otitis media checklist item left not reported: only 'recurrent otitis media' and 'chronic discharging otitis media' are denied (narrower items). Lower respiratory tract infection excluded from 'without any respiratory tract involvement until 13 years of age' plus 'no ... pneumonia'. Sepsis left not reported: 'Blood culture grew no organisms' refers to one admission culture (recorded as excluded 'positive blood culture'). Normal T/B cells, immunoglobulins, liver and kidney function recorded as excluded abnormalities per D-27. Impaired wound healing marked observed from 'the very slow healing process' of the chronic ulcers. Umbilical cord: separation at 13 days and 'did not have any undue problems' -> delayed separation excluded. No contradictions about presence of features found.
